input: Buy birthday presents for all nephews in advance

gold.taskTitle: Buy Birthday Presents for All Nephews in Advance
gold.taskDescription: Plan and purchase birthday gifts for all nephews ahead of their birthdays to avoid last-minute stress.

questions.title: How many nephews are you buying gifts for?
questions.description: Establish the total number of nephews to determine the scope of the task.

questions.title: What are their ages or age ranges?
questions.description: Understand the age of each nephew to guide age-appropriate gift selection.

questions.title: When are their birthdays throughout the year?
questions.description: Identify the upcoming birthday dates to prioritize who needs a gift soonest.

questions.title: What is your total budget across all gifts?
questions.description: Determine the overall spending limit to plan purchases accordingly.

questions.title: Do you have gift ideas already, or need suggestions?
questions.description: Find out whether the user needs help brainstorming gifts or already has specific items in mind.

questions.title: Will you shop online, in stores, or both?
questions.description: Clarify the preferred shopping method to tailor the action steps.

questions.title: How far in advance do you want gifts purchased?
questions.description: Establish the lead time before each birthday by which gifts should be bought and ready.
